//: OpenCues compatibility manifest for Chrome. Chrome auto-updates itself, so we don't pin a version — we declare the minimum required (driven by the CSS Custom Highlight API). Update.cjs --check on chrome is informational only (no auto-upgrade path).
min-version-reason: CSS Custom Highlight API (Highlight.range, document.highlights) reached stable in Chrome 121.

known-incompatible.reason: CSS Custom Highlight API not available — extension renders no highlights.
